question:
Identify the incorrectly spelt word and select its correct spelling.

Wether we want to admit it or not, we all wish everyone would like us.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"whether"** is a conjunction used to introduce alternatives or possibilities. (चाहे)

 
 
• **Example: **I am not sure whether I will attend the meeting.
 
 
 
• **"Wether" **is an incorrect spelling and does not have any meaning in English. The correct spelling is "whether". (चाहे)
 
 
• **Example: **I can't decide whether to go to the party or stay home.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Admitt** (स्वीकार करना): Incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is "admit".

 
 
• **Example:** He had to admit that he was wrong.
 
 
 
• **Addmit** (स्वीकार करना): Incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is "admit".
 
 
• **Example:** She refused to admit her mistake.
 
 
 
• **Whither** (किधर): Means to what place or state.
 
 
• **Example:** Whither are we bound?
